name: sf-data-migrator
description: Chrome extension: discover related Salesforce records and export or migrate them between orgs

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version;require('child_process').execSync('cd dist && zip -qr ../sf-data-migrator-extension-v'+v+'.zip .',{stdio:'inherit'})"
